result: The registered post-grant preflight verified the date, Git target, registration, host binaries, first-party login state, public source snapshot, common candidate.5 bytes, supported schema, isolated plugin installation, exact package bytes and empty isolated MCP configuration without making a model call. The parent then used the case-insensitive PowerShell variable name $home, which collided with the read-only system $HOME variable. The intended task-home value was not assigned and the authorized authentication hardlink was created at C:/Users/15521/auth.json instead of inside the task root. The parent disclosed the error, verified the two hardlink names without reading credential contents, requested exact cleanup approval, removed only the erroneous link, preserved the original authentication file and removed the entire task root. The unnecessary recovery approval is a material collaboration-loss event and the cleanup wait crossed the registered 2026-08-14 date boundary. The immutable stop rule therefore fired before either host model call. This result makes zero O1-O5 progress.

causalFinding.fact: The registered target, public source snapshot, common Skill/profile bytes, output schema and isolated Codex plugin package passed pre-model checks, but a parent PowerShell variable collision redirected the authentication hardlink to the user-home root.
causalFinding.inference: The host and package route was not falsified; the failed boundary was the parent's temporary-path construction and its recovery process. Reusing an unchecked system-like variable name can convert an otherwise bounded reversible operation into an out-of-root side effect.
causalFinding.correction: Do not edit or retry the expired registration. A later registration may reuse the unchanged host/package route only with a task-specific variable name, an exact resolved-path equality check immediately before link creation, a post-create hardlink-name check before any auth or model command, and the same one-call, no-retry, cleanup and claim floors. Do not add a runtime, credential manager, plugin manager or product protocol.

It proves no Codex or Claude task outcome, no cross-host equivalence, no O5 progress, no release eligibility, no publication, no production readiness and no v0.2 completion.
